negative_reviews.author: Fiona Yu
negative_reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ (1/5)

Very disappointing experience. We came back because our first visit was good, but the quality has dropped dramatically.

The so-called soft-boiled ramen egg was completely hard-boiled with no runny yolk at all. The pork katsu was badly overcooked and black on the outside, making it dry, unpleasant and impossible to eat. Even more disappointing, the "Japanese " tonkotsu served with the ramen was just small pieces of shredded pork, not proper slices of tonkotsu as you would expect from a Japanese restaurant.

This was nowhere near the standard a restaurant serving Japanese food should offer. The food quality was extremely poor and nothing like our previous visit 9 months ago.

The only positive was that the staff were friendly and helpful. The ramen were remade and they apologized for the batch of fully boiled eggs (yet they still served them to customers) with a slightly discounted price. Unfortunately good service could not make up for the very disappointing food. The chef should genuinely understands and delivers the authenticity of the food they are selling.

Sadly, we won't be returning unless the food quality improves significantly.
